title: Titanium Acoustic Waveguide Extension
alloyReason: Triaxially forged Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (Triaxially Forged) (UNS R56400) is specified for this ultrasonic tooling component where isotropic properties are mandatory. The 3D forging eliminates texture directionality, delivering uniform 950 MPa tensile in all orientations under multi-axial stress. This rationale is driven by acoustic waveguide extension bar and fat life requirements.
process: CNC turn-mill multi-axis for ultrasonic tooling geometry
Shot peening Almen at 200W fiber laser
Black oxide/DLC coating at 200W fiber laser
CMM SPC dimensional check at 200W fiber laser
surfaceTreatment: DLC coating 2um, 15GPa hardness, 0.1mu friction coefficient applied to wear surfaces for extended durability — tailored for acoustic waveguide extension application
commonFailures: Corrosion pitting in road salt exposure - mitigated by DLC 2um 15GPa + hot wax sealant — critical for acoustic waveguide extension performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Acoustic Waveguide Extension suitable for Acoustic waveguide extension bar?
faq.a: Titanium Acoustic Waveguide Extension uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address ultrasonic tooling operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Acoustic Waveguide Extension?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Acoustic Waveguide Extension is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for acoustic waveguide extension requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Acoustic Waveguide Extension require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. acoustic waveguide extension components require DLC coating 2um, 15GPa hardness, 0.1mu friction coefficient applied to wear surfaces for extended durability — tailored for acoustic waveguide extension application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Acoustic Waveguide Extension shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Acoustic Waveguide Extension includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet acoustic waveguide extension specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Waveguide bar / Extension bar ultrasonic tooling components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
